bio: Situated in the heart of the City Centre, Glasgow Marriott is a 4-star hotel, and located near Scottish Exhibition & Conference Centre, Burrell Collection, and the Gallery of Modern Art. Whether you are enjoying Afternoon Tea for business or social, Glasgow Marriott Hotel can cater to you.  Afternoon Tea is served in the contemporary bar or lounge area, where you can tuck into an array of fresh finger sandwiches, the chef's mini patisserie selection, and scones with clotted cream & jam, you can even choose a Gin & Tonic from their bespoke Gin Bar to accompany your Afternoon Tea.
